Chapter 7089: Apocalypse

Chapter 7089: Apocalypse

“I see, then I’ll send you on your way.” Li Qiye stared at the group with a smile.

“No!” Zhao Dachui and the others became alarmed.

Li Qiye waved and pulled the entire ocean into his palm.

“Don’t!” The celestial immortals understood what he wanted to do.

“Kill him!” Demise and Slayer shouted, prepping an attack.

Alas, they couldn’t break through the coiled ocean. Explosions occurred like countless volcanoes erupting due to the tribulations running wild.

Li Qiye took over the ocean and sent the tribulations at the weakened celestial immortals.

Overlord and regular immortals died instantly. Nonetheless, the celestial immortals survived despite the attached life force dispersing.

Alas, their struggle was useless because Li Qiye began closing his palms, constricting the ocean into the size of a crystal ball. The tribulations became dazzling during the refinement process.

“No!” They screamed in despair and unwillingness. They had died before but at the very least, they regained a form of life again in this ocean.

Now, the refinement of this ocean would truly erase them from existence. He went through several cycles before fully refining all the cultivators and tribulations into worldly essences and life liquid.

He spread his hands and released them back into the world. The sheer abundance proliferated beyond Dusk Realm and Heavenfall Path. It reached all corners of Ruin, bringing life back to the desolate world.

This nourished lifeforms despite the presence of deadly tribulations.

“Will Ruin be reborn?” Immortals observed the colossal flow of life force.

“As long as there is enough time, Ruin will be prosperous once more.” A golden immortal concluded.

Ruin was different than Stygian, only having been destroyed. Its worldly energy was still present and not devoured.

“Boom!” Meanwhile, lightning bolts flashed everywhere in Heavenrealm. All inhabitants, celestial immortals included, felt as if they had just been whipped mercilessly. The pain suffocated them.

“What power is this?!” Immortals’ souls nearly scattered.

The celestial ones recognized that this was something from the high heaven - an invisible hand capable of crushing their throat.

Alas, this only lasted a split second. When they looked up again, they saw the sunny sky.

Only the most observant noted a strange phenomenon far above the surface - the accumulation of dark clouds and tribulations.

This went beyond just hitting a single world. All of Heavenrealm was part of the radius.

“The apocalypse, it’s finally here.” A celestial immortal in a hidden location murmured.

“The end is near.” Another celestial immortal’s expression darkened.
